svg.title: The Krumpir bench in isometric view, with the potato in the loop
svg.desc: A PC, a Raspberry Pi and an ESP32 on a platform, connected by cables: a network cable from the PC to the Pi and a USB cable from the PC to the ESP32. The UART loop between the Pi and the ESP32 runs through a potato with a copper and a zinc electrode, so the potato is in the loop.
